annotations.title: 会社名の一覧に法人番号をまとめて付ける

description: Match a list of company names (e.g. a customer list, sales list, or vendor master from a spreadsheet) to corporate numbers in one go (名寄せ). Each row gets a confidence: 'confident' (safe to use), 'review' (several close candidates; show them to the user), or 'unmatched'. Pass up to 50 names per call; adding a prefecture per row improves accuracy. The job usually finishes within seconds. If it is still running when this tool returns, call it again with the returned job_id (and no companies) to fetch the result; do not resubmit the list. Uses batch-row quota (Free plan: 50 rows per month). For a single company, bango_find_company is cheaper.

companies.description: 会社名の配列（1〜50件）。文字列か {name, prefecture} の形

job_id.description: 前回の呼び出しで返った job_id。結果の取得だけを行う
